submit: Primary action button on forms, used to submit data
cancel: Secondary button to close dialogs or cancel operations without saving
save: Button to save current changes, usually in forms or editors
delete: Destructive action button, requires confirmation before executing
welcome: Greeting message shown on the homepage hero section
welcomeUser: Personalized greeting with user's name, shown after login. {name} is a placeholder
errorNetworkTimeout: Error message when API request times out, tone should be apologetic and helpful
errorNotFound: 404 error message shown when a page or resource doesn't exist
itemCount: Shows number of items in a list or cart. {count} is a number placeholder
itemCountPlural: Pluralized version of item count using ICU format
navHome: Navigation menu item for homepage, not the noun 'house'
navSettings: Navigation menu item for settings page
navProfile: Navigation menu item for user profile page
settingsLanguage: Label for language selection dropdown in settings
settingsTheme: Label for theme (dark/light mode) toggle in settings
settingsNotifications: Label for notification preferences section in settings
confirmDelete: Confirmation dialog message before deleting an item, should convey seriousness
loading: Loading indicator text, shown while content is being fetched
retry: Button to retry a failed operation
searchPlaceholder: Placeholder text in search input field
